# RSV VACCINE

Vaccination is recommended to protect adults aged 75 years and older from severe Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) infection. Vaccination consists of a single dose of either available vaccine formulation (GlaxoSmithKline or Pfizer).

People 60-74 years may receive the vaccine if they have a risk factor for severe RSV disease.

## Inpatient

Order:
RSV vaccine once

## \*Pregnant patients - Order Abrysvo once dose from drug file

## Outpatient

mRESVIA order:
RSV (mRESVIA) vaccine once dose (not approved for pregnant patients)

*Local guidance (St. Cloud CDSS, Inpatient):*
VHA suggests that clinicians may offer a single dose of either Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) vaccine (GlaxoSmithKline or Pfizer) to adults aged 60 years or older. The decision to receive an RSV vaccine should include the patient's preferences and values regarding benefits and harms related to the patients risk for severe RSV-associated disease and known vaccine harm. Patients should only receive a vaccination if they request vaccination after shared decision making.
